meta.name: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy
meta.description: In a strange galaxy far, far away, the evil Scorpius attacks an innocent planet. Five brave teenagers rush to defend it and discover that they have been chosen to be protectors of the universe.

videos.name: Quasar Quest (1)
videos.overview: An adventurous young man embarks on an epic adventure in space when he sneaks aboard the massive space colony Terra Venture.
videos.description: An adventurous young man embarks on an epic adventure in space when he sneaks aboard the massive space colony Terra Venture.
